observed_mechanics: Keep the stream subobject in ESI and zero AL.

File path: load the file stream vtable word at this+0x28, load its slot +0x10 into EDX, and call it with ECX set to the file stream subobject.
TEST EAX,EAX; on zero divert to the memory path.

File path: recover data from the adjusted frame, load the write slot +0x38 from the file stream vtable, push size then data, set ECX to the file stream, and call it. Return that 32-bit result's low byte with RET 0x8.
Memory path: load the memory stream vtable word at this+0x04, load slot +0x38, form ECX as this+0x04, restore the frame, and tail-jump to the slot so the callee pops the two argument words.
